name: MI-09
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a PVI of R+16
Incumbent Lisa McClain has a massive financial advantage ($5.2M raised vs $8K)
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~95%
No competitive polling or expert ratings signal a race
model.rationale: McClain combines a heavily Republican district, incumbency, and an overwhelming fundraising edge against a Democratic challenger who has raised almost nothing. Markets price her win at roughly 95%, consistent with a Safe R rating.
model.watch: A major late outside-spending intervention or unexpected scandal could move the race, but nothing currently suggests competitiveness.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Lisa McClain seeks another term in a Michigan district that leans strongly Republican, with a partisan advantage of about 16 points. She has raised over $5.2 million and holds more than $1.5 million on hand, while Democratic challenger Ray Pooley has raised under $10,000. No outside groups are opposing her, and no public polling of the race exists.

Prediction markets give Republicans roughly a 95% chance of holding the seat, and no expert raters flag it as competitive. The fundamentals, money, and market pricing all point the same direction, making this a Safe Republican hold with only minor residual uncertainty.
